why: Post-snapshot work targets ES(7)=33, the first open case of the exact Erdős–Szekeres formula ES(n)=2^(n-2)+1: Baek's 'The Erdős–Szekeres Conjecture Revisited' (SoCG 2025) and Bogdan's Dec 2025 'Notes on the 33-point Erdős–Szekeres problem' report SAT-based UNSAT certificates for anchored subfamilies, though a complete proof of ES(7)=33 is not yet claimed.
